title: IOT DATA TRUST EVALUATION VIA MACHINE LEARNING
reasoning: The paper discusses 'data trust' in the context of IoT sensor data, which refers to the reliability and integrity of the data. It aims to distinguish trustworthy from untrustworthy data based on technical quality (e.g., presence of errors, noise, malicious manipulation, system failures). This is a technical evaluation of data integrity and reliability, not an evaluation of religious beliefs, moral principles, or ethical frameworks.
